title: Fixed Single String Stave and Open Gourd Musical Bow
description: One newly authored complete single-string musical-bow exterior with a genuine open gourd resonator, laid down in one fixed display pose. One full continuously singly curved round wooden stave joins two end bindings and one whole tip-to-tip metal-string appearance. A separate thick bulbous gourd shell with a wide open mouth, full inner wall and blind inner floor sits outside the lower side of the bow, attached by a finite saddle and complete closed binding appearances. The string remains clear of the gourd cavity. Unlike the earlier double-recurve sport bow, there are no two reflex tips or broad central handgrip, and no arrow. Unlike the spike fiddle, there is no straight neck passing through a hexagonal membrane body, peg pair, bridge or two strings over a soundboard; the open side gourd and full arched stave define this whole instrument. All numeric geometry new, no old bow or vessel imported or split. Four opaque PBR roles, metres Z up, whole horizontal bounds centred and a finite gourd underside at Z0. One whole prop zero scenes. Generic berimbau-inspired static art, not a historically exact or verified playable example: no striker or shaker supplied, no acoustics, pitch, string tension, bow elasticity, secure tying, playing posture, manufacture, stability or safe-use claim. No rigging, animation or interaction.
